prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1119; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient was turning left, with a reported impact to the wrist. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a fracture of the wrist. No prior injury to the same body area is known to this provider. The causal link between this incident and the fracture is not yet clear and is still under review. Five visits were completed. Treatment followed a usual course, including immobilization, pain management, and follow-up imaging, and tapered off as the patient improved. Function has returned to near baseline, with residual stiffness expected to resolve with routine home exercises. Two similar billing charges from the same day are currently being verified by the office. Ongoing monitoring is recommended, and the patient will be seen again if symptoms worsen or fail to improve as expected.
